title: A GPU-accelerated Nonlinear Branch-and-Bound Framework for Sparse Linear Models
summary: We study exact sparse linear regression with an $\ell_0-\ell_2$ penalty and develop a branch-and-bound (BnB) algorithm explicitly designed for GPU execution. Starting from a perspective reformulation, we derive an interval relaxation that can be solved by ADMM with closed-form, coordinate-wise updates. We structure these updates so that the main work at each BnB node reduces to batched matrix-vector operations with a shared data matrix, enabling fine-grained parallelism across coordinates and coarse-grained parallelism across many BnB nodes on a single GPU.
